name: White House
description: Follow White House, a tracked organization, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: What’s missing from the White House plan for the future of US science
changes.summary: Nature, Published online: 04 August 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02384-w To realize ‘a new golden age for science’, the United States needs open borders and must properly fund studies in the social sciences, public health and the humanities — not just research in technology and engineering.

changes.title: White House declassifies info on secret FBI probe into whether Trump fired Comey at Russia's behest, official says
changes.summary: The White House has declassified information claiming the FBI probed whether President Trump acted as a Russian asset when he fired James Comey, a theory an administration official said wasn't backed up by evidence.

changes.title: Pirro Meets With Trump at the White House After He Said She ‘Choked’ in Reflecting Pool Case
changes.summary: President Trump said Jeanine Pirro, the U.S. attorney for Washington, D.C., “folded like an umbrella.” For now, her job appeared to be safe, according to two people familiar with the meeting.

changes.title: Trump and White House officials hope Rep. Max Miller ends reelection bid, sources say
changes.summary: President Trump and other officials hope embattled GOP Rep. Max Miller exits the congressional race in Ohio immediately, multiple U.S. officials familiar with the matter tell CBS News. CBS News' Taurean Small has more.

changes.title: Behind closed doors, Trump, White House aides hope Rep. Max Miller exits race
changes.summary: Some White House officials hope embattled GOP Rep. Max Miller exits his congressional race immediately, and President Trump has expressed a similar sentiment, multiple sources say.

changes.title: These 25 U.S. States Are Suing the Trump Administration. Here's Why
changes.summary: President Donald Trump speaks to the media in the Oval Office of the White House in Washington, D.C. on Aug. 3, 2026. —Chip Somodevilla––Getty Images A coalition of 25 U.S. states is suing the Trump Administration , arguing the President’s latest round of sweeping tariffs on over 80 countries exceed his legal authority.
